query: Why are different Contribute As You Earn (CAYE) contribution rates applied to different service fees?
reference_answer: Contribute As You Earn (CAYE) contribution rates may change when you (i) update your CAYE contribution rate or (ii) are no longer required to make CAYE contributions. Generally, the updated CAYE contribution rate will apply to service fees paid from the next day.
